name: plumbing_export_flags
description: Test 12, export flags (6.3 step 2.3, 6.7 step 7, PL7; hand-derived). The plumbing simulator only ever calls SetFlags(0x08, true) per network in state 4 and SetFlags(0x20, true) in state 8; it never clears a flag. Two networks, each a pump of 1000 (water at (5,4); the far pump's nearest water is 26 cells away, > 1, so its capacity is 100 % of 1000): 'near' at (5,5) on the pipe row x = 5..9 whose end (9,5) is the export connection, and 'far' at (30,30) alone. 'far' is inserted last, so it is first in the producer list and seeded first: take = min(400 - 0, 1000) = 400 > 0 but the connection is not in its bitmap -> SetFlags(0x08, true) [quirk: per network]. The second network ('near') reaches it: exported 400, used 400, supply 600. The pass takes 2N + 7 = 11 calls. At state 8 used 400 = amount, so no 0x20: the deal ends with flags 0x08 only. Water used: 'far' ratio 0 / 1000 -> 0; 'near' (0 + 400) / 1000 = 0.4f -> trunc(1000 x 0.4f) = 400. Then both pumps are removed (no producer, no import: no network, 7 calls): no deal is flagged in state 4, and at state 8 used 0 < 400 -> SetFlags(0x20, true) only; with the earlier flags reset to 0 the deal ends with 0x20. (The unreachable-only case, 0x08 in state 4 then 0x20 in state 8 = 0x28, is in pl14_12_export.)
